subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box. 0.5  10 =
stimulus: shall make be get have utilize try take use stay The sun (a) ⎯⎯ the main source of energy. With the advancement of science and technology, scientists all over the world have made substantial progress in (b) ⎯⎯ solar energy in order to (c) ⎯⎯ our life happy and comfortable. At present the scientists everywhere in the world (d) ⎯⎯ utilizing this solar energy for various purposes. Now it is (e) ⎯⎯ mechanically for pumping water, heating homes and offices. Still scientists have (f) ⎯⎯ their best for utilizing solar energy for the greater benefit of mankind. We (g) ⎯⎯ lucky enough that we (h) ⎯⎯ this energy plentifully at our disposal. Proper steps (i) ⎯⎯ therefore, be (j) ⎯⎯ for utilizing this energy for our further benefits.
guide_solution: Right form of verbs (a) is (b) utilizing (c) make (d) have been (e) being used (f) been trying (g) are (h) get (i) should (j) taken
